DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込額を確認されたいのですね。金額がいくつか書かれた案内をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to check the transfer amount. Have you brought information listing several amounts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃の紙です。家賃の欄の数字を入れようとしましたが、下に別の合計もあって迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一つの欄だけで振込額を決めかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a rent notice. I was about to enter the figure in the rent column, but there is another total below and I am unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you nearly decided the transfer amount from just one field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの金額を支払う必要があるかは、こちらで判断できません。請求元の説明で、合計の中身は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine here which amount you must pay. Have you checked what the total includes in the biller's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内訳は確かめていません。家賃のほかに別の費用欄があるので、合計を見ずに進めるところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 合計の理由を請求元へ聞く必要を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not checked the breakdown. There is another charge besides rent, so I was about to proceed without looking at the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the need to ask the biller why that is the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実行前に請求元へ問い合わせましょう。口座の案内も、ご自身で確認できる書面にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Contact the biller before executing the transfer. Are the account details also on a document you can check yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約時にもらった書面があります。まず請求元へ金額の内訳を聞いて、振込先が変わっていないかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求内訳と振込先変更の有無を問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the document received when signing the contract. I will first ask the biller for the breakdown and also check whether the destination account has changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the bill breakdown and whether the transfer destination has changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認後は、その回答と画面を照合してください。振込の費用は請求額とは別なので、利用する方法の案内もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After confirmation, compare that response with the screen. Transfer costs are separate from the billed amount, so check the instructions for your chosen method too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 請求の合計と振込手数料を同じ数字と思わないようにします。手数料がどこに出るか、確定する前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確定前に銀行の費用表示を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will avoid treating the bill total and transfer fee as the same amount. Please show me where the fee appears before I confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand the bank's cost display before confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認画面の案内でお確かめいただけます。不明な項目が残る場合は、支払いを実行する前に担当へご質問ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check using the confirmation-screen guidance. If any items remain unclear, ask the staff before executing payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 請求元から回答が来るまで入力を進めません。内訳と口座を照合し、さらに振込の費用も確認してから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内訳と口座と振込費用が不明なまま実行しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not continue entering information until the biller replies. I will compare the breakdown and account, check transfer costs too, and then decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not execute while the breakdown, account or transfer costs remain unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 請求元へ聞くことと銀行で確認することを分けられましたね。案内をお持ちになって、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have distinguished what to ask the biller from what to check with the bank. Please take your information sheet and travel home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会員の画面をお出しですね。ポイントの提示ですか、それともお支払い方法のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have your membership screen open. Are you presenting points, or asking about payment methods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この画面を見せれば会計も済むと思っていました。ポイント用と書いてありますが、支払いにも使えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提示だけで決済と思ったことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought showing this screen also completed payment. It says it is for points, but can it be used for payment too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought presenting the screen alone completed payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この表示はポイントの提示用です。お支払いは別に確認しますので、画面を見せたことだけで完了とは思わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This display is for presenting points. Payment is checked separately, so please do not think it is complete just because you showed the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ポイントをつけることと払うことは別なのですね。支払いの方法を、レジの案内で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レジの支払方法を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So earning points and paying are separate. I would like to see the payment methods in the register instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the register's payment methods separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる方法はこちらで確認できます。その間に、袋のご希望も伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the available methods here. Meanwhile, may I also ask whether you want bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の袋を二つ持っています。卵は軽いほうの袋に分けたいので、袋は追加しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加袋なしで軽い品を分ける希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have two bags of my own. I want to put the eggs separately in the lighter bag, so I do not need another bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to separate the light items without an additional bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参の袋をお使いですね。支払いはどの方法をご希望ですか。合計も画面で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You are using your own bags. Which payment method would you like? Please check the total on the screen too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金で払います。まだポイントを見せただけなので、合計を確認してからお金を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会員提示後に合計を見て支払いへ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will pay cash. I have only shown points so far, so I will check the total before taking out the money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After presenting membership, check the total and proceed with payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、現金での受付へ進みます。レシートを受け取ったら、ポイントとお買い上げの内容をそれぞれご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will proceed with cash payment. Once you receive the receipt, please check the points and purchased items separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: レシートを受け取って確認したいです。支払った内容を見て、卵を分けて詰めてから帰ります。ポイントの提示だけでは終わらないと覚えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い内容を確かめ提示のみの誤解を解消する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to receive and check the receipt. I will look at what I paid for, pack the eggs separately and go home. I have learned that showing points alone does not finish payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check payment details and clear up the misunderstanding that presentation alone completes it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの表示が読み分けられましたね。レシートと持参袋をお忘れなく、お気をつけてお帰りくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have distinguished the two displays. Remember your receipt and own bags, and please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その経路の数字をご覧になっていますね。歩く時間の目安をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the route's number. Are you looking for an estimated walking time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 横の数字が十五なので、十五分で一周できると思いました。途中で休んでも二十分くらいで戻れるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一周と休憩を短時間でできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The number beside it is fifteen, so I thought I could complete a circuit in fifteen minutes. Could I return in about twenty minutes even with a rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a circuit and rest can be completed in a short time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図の数字は経路の番号です。下の凡例に距離の表示がありますが、番号から歩く時間はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The figures on this map are route numbers. The legend below shows distances, but a route number does not tell you walking time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十五は道の番号だったのですね。休みを含めた時間だと勘違いしていました。短い経路を選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図の凡例で短い案を選び直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So fifteen was the route number. I mistakenly thought it was the time including rest. I would like to choose a shorter route instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the map legend to choose a shorter option again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 凡例で距離の線を見て比べましょう。池へ向かう道より、近い休憩所までの往復という案もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Compare the distance lines in the legend. Another option is an out-and-back walk to the nearby rest area rather than the path toward the pond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩所まで行って戻る案にします。私はゆっくり歩くので、距離だけで何分と決めないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 距離だけで所要分数を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will choose going to the rest area and back. I walk slowly, so I do not want to decide the minutes from distance alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not determine the required minutes from distance alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中で休む時間も合わせて考えましょう。行く前に戻る道を図で確かめておくと、折り返す判断もしやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Include time for resting too. Checking the return route on the map before setting off also makes it easier to decide when to turn back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に休憩所から入口へ戻る道を覚えます。思ったより時間がかかったら、先へ進まずそこで戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩地点で折り返して先へ進まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will first learn the route from the rest area to the entrance. If it takes longer than expected, I will turn back there instead of going farther.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Turn back at the rest area rather than continuing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その計画なら歩いた様子に合わせて変えられますね。図にない路面の状態は、実際に見ながら確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That plan can change according to how the walk goes. Check actual surface conditions as you go, since they are not shown on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道の番号と距離を分けて読み、途中で時計を見ます。休憩所まででも疲れたら、短く切り上げて入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実際の疲れに合わせ短く切り上げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read the route number separately from distance and check my watch along the way. If tired even before reaching the rest area, I will cut the walk short and return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Cut the walk short according to actual fatigue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 数字の意味を確かめてから選べましたね。無理のない距離で休憩も取り、散歩をお楽しみになってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You chose after checking what the numbers meant. Enjoy a manageable walk with rests too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発車時刻が過ぎていますが、この列車をお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The departure time has passed. Are you waiting for this train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。小城で同僚が迎えに来るので、いつ動くのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小城で同僚が迎えに来るため発車見込みを知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A colleague is meeting me at Ogi, so I want to know when it will depart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a colleague will meet you at Ogi and you want the expected departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 前の列車が遅れています。こちらはあと十分ほどで発車する見込みですが、まだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The preceding train is delayed. This one is expected to leave in about ten minutes, but that is not confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分後に出る可能性がある、ということですね。小城への到着も十分ほど遅れそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十分後は確定ではないと確認して到着の遅れを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it may leave in ten minutes. Is arrival at Ogi also likely to be about ten minutes late?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm ten minutes is not definite and ask about the arrival delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の見込みではそうです。ただ、途中でさらに遅れる場合もあるので、到着時刻は約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is the current expectation. However, further delays may occur on the way, so we cannot promise an arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら同僚には、駅へ出る前に私からの連絡を待ってもらいます。発車が決まったら知らせていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同僚には連絡を待ってもらい発車確定時の案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask my colleague to wait for my message before leaving for the station. Could you let me know once departure is confirmed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your colleague will wait for contact and ask for an announcement when departure is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発車の準備が整い次第、放送します。改札内でお待ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will announce it as soon as departure preparations are complete. Will you wait inside the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話をかけたいので、まだ改札の外にいます。放送はここでも聞こえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話のため改札外にいると伝えて放送を聞けるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am still outside the gates because I want to make a phone call. Can I hear the announcement here too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are outside the gates to telephone and check whether announcements can be heard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この待合スペースでも聞こえます。電話中に聞き逃したら、こちらの窓口でお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can hear it in this waiting area too. If you miss it while on the phone, please ask at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで連絡を済ませて待ちます。発車の放送を聞いたら、同僚にも改めて知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話後に待ち発車放送を聞いて同僚へ再連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will finish contacting them here and wait. After hearing the departure announcement, I will update my colleague too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait after the call, listen to the departure announcement and contact your colleague again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。乗り場へ移動するときは足元にお気をつけて。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Watch your step when moving to the platform. Have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活相談の予約についてはこちらです。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is where you book daily-life consultations. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の部屋から夜中に大きな音がします。管理会社には話しましたが、変わらなくて困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜間の騒音と管理会社に相談しても改善していない状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is loud noise from the next room in the middle of the night. I told the management company, but nothing has changed and I am troubled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe nighttime noise that has not improved despite consulting the management company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これまでの対応も含めて相談員がお話を伺えます。この窓口では、火曜の午後を予約制にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The adviser can listen, including what has been done so far. This counter offers appointments on Tuesday afternoons.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 火曜は仕事なので、まず電話で相談内容を伝えて予約することはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 火曜は仕事と説明し電話で内容を伝えて予約できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I work on Tuesdays. Could I first explain the matter over the phone and make a booking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you work Tuesday and ask whether you can explain and book by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この案内の番号で受け付けます。対面相談の別日をご希望なら、電話で空きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, we accept calls at the number on this information sheet. If you want another day for an in-person consultation, ask by phone about availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相談するとき、何時にどんな音がしたか書いたメモを持っていけばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音がした日時と内容のメモでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: For the consultation, should I bring notes of what time and what kind of noise occurred?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether notes of noise dates, times and details are suitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時と音の様子、管理会社に伝えた日をまとめていただくと、経緯がわかりやすいです。記録できなかった日を推測で埋める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Summarizing dates, times, the noise and the day you told management helps us understand the history. You do not need to fill unrecorded days with guesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 録音はありません。メモにも抜けがありますが、覚えていることと確かでないことを分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録音がなくメモも不完全なので確かなことと不確かなことを分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have no recording. My notes have gaps too, but I will write what I remember separately from what is uncertain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there is no recording and notes are incomplete, so you will separate certain and uncertain information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで構いません。相談しただけで音が止まるとはお約束できませんが、取れる対応を一緒に整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. We cannot promise the noise will stop just from consulting, but we will organize possible responses together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずこの番号に電話して別日の空きを聞きます。それまでに管理会社とのやり取りも日付順にまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話で別日の空きを聞き管理会社との連絡を日付順に整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first call this number and ask about another day's availability. By then I will also put my exchanges with management in date order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will call about another day and organize communications with management chronologically. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご案内をお持ちください。お電話をお待ちしています。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the information. We look forward to your call. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はお済みですね。何か確認しておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have finished payment. Is there anything you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場に今日受診したことを示す書類を出す必要があります。この領収書だけで足りるのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日の受診を証明する必要があり領収書で足りるか迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to submit a document at work showing I attended today. I am unsure whether this receipt alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you need proof of today's visit and are unsure whether a receipt is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が必要としている項目は、受診日でしょうか。それとも診断名や休む期間も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does work need the visit date, or also a diagnosis and the period of absence?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受診日と私の名前だけでよいと言われました。診断名は書かなくていいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名前と受診日だけが必要で診断名は不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said just the visit date and my name. They say the diagnosis does not need to be written.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say only name and visit date are needed, not the diagnosis. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、その条件を文書受付に伝えてみてください。領収書でよいかは職場に確認が必要ですが、別の書類についても相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell those conditions to the document desk. Work must confirm whether a receipt is acceptable, but you can also ask about another document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 領収書の原本は自分で保管したいです。受診日だけの証明を申し込む窓口へ案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 領収書は保管し別の受診証明を申し込む窓口への案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to keep the original receipt myself. Could you guide me to the desk to apply for proof just of the visit date?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for guidance to a separate visit-certificate desk while keeping your receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付の右側が文書受付です。発行できる書式や費用、受け取りまでの日数は、そちらで確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The document desk is to the right of reception. Ask there about available formats, costs and days until collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日が提出期限です。間に合わなかった場合に備えて、申し込み時に受け取れる控えがあるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日が期限で間に合わない場合の申し込み控えについて尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The submission deadline is tomorrow. In case it is not ready in time, I also want to ask whether I can receive a record when applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the deadline is tomorrow and you want to ask about an application record if issuance is too late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期限も最初にお伝えください。控えを出せるかを含めて担当者がご案内します。職場にも期限を延ばせるか相談しておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: State the deadline at the beginning too. The staff will explain, including whether they can issue a record. It would also be good to ask work whether the deadline can be extended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 文書受付で期限と必要な項目を伝えます。すぐに出せない場合は、職場へ連絡して提出日を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付で条件を伝え即日発行できなければ職場と提出日を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the document desk the deadline and required items. If it cannot be issued immediately, I will contact work and discuss the submission date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give the desk the conditions and consult work about the submission date if same-day issuance is impossible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、領収書もお持ちになってください。お大事になさってください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the receipt too. Take care of yourself and travel home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物をされたとのことですね。まず、なくした物の種類から伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have lost something. May I first ask what kind of item it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紺色の折り畳み傘です。今日の昼、バスを降りてから見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紺色の折り畳み傘を昼のバス降車後になくしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A navy folding umbrella. I have not seen it since getting off the bus at noon today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe losing a navy folding umbrella after getting off the midday bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に傘を見た場所と、降りた時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me where you last saw it and when you got off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十一時半ごろ、バスの座席横に袋ごと置いたのを覚えています。十二時ごろ終点で降りましたが、そのとき持ったかどうかは確かではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十一時半に座席横へ置き十二時ごろ降りたが降車時に持ったかは不確かと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remember putting it in its bag beside the bus seat around eleven thirty. I got off at the terminus around twelve, but am not certain whether I took it then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you left it beside the seat at eleven thirty and got off around twelve but are unsure whether you took it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、車内に残した可能性がありますね。柄や袋に、ほかの傘と区別できる印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It may have remained on the bus. Does the handle or bag have a mark distinguishing it from other umbrellas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち手に黄色い糸を巻いてあります。袋の底は自分で縫い直したので、白い縫い目が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち手の黄色い糸と袋底の白い縫い目を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrapped yellow thread around the handle. I repaired the bag's bottom myself, so white stitching is visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the yellow thread on the handle and white stitches at the bag bottom. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴も記録します。似た紺色の傘は届いていますが、糸の印はないので、ご本人の物とはまだ確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record those features too. A similar navy umbrella has been handed in, but it has no thread mark, so we cannot confirm it is yours yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 色だけでは決められませんね。そちらは受け取らず、バス会社にも問い合わせます。届け出はここでできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色だけで自分の物と判断せずバス会社にも聞くとして届け出を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Colour alone is not enough. I will not take that one, and will ask the bus company too. Can I file a report here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume ownership from colour alone; say you will ask the bus company too and want to file a report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この用紙に連絡先をご記入ください。受理後に控えをお渡ししますので、問い合わせの際はその番号をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, fill your contact details in this form. We will give you a record after accepting it; state that number when enquiring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先を書きました。控えを保管して、まずバス会社に黄色い糸と白い縫い目を伝えて探してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を書き控えを保管してバス会社へ特徴を伝えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my contact details. I will keep the record, first tell the bus company about the yellow thread and white stitching, and ask them to search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you filled your contact details, will keep the record and describe the features to the bus company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで受け付けます。該当する物が見つかれば連絡します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it here. We will contact you if a matching item is found. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その不在票のお荷物を取りに来られたのですね。宛名を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come to collect the parcel on that missed-delivery slip. Let us check the addressee together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事帰りに取りに来ました。自分の荷物だと思っていたのですが、宛名を見ると兄の名前でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分宛てと思った不在票が兄宛てだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came after work. I thought it was mine, but the addressee is my older brother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the missed-delivery slip you thought was yours is addressed to your older brother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お兄様宛てですね。荷物の種類によって代理で受け取れる条件が違うので、不在票を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is addressed to your brother. Conditions for collection by a representative vary by parcel type; may I check the slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。兄は私と同じ住所に住んでいますが、今夜は夜勤で来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 兄は同じ住所に住むが今夜は夜勤で来られないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. My brother lives at my address, but cannot come tonight because of his night shift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your brother lives at the same address but cannot come tonight due to night work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この票だけでは代理受け取りの条件が確認できません。こちらで荷物の記録を調べます。お兄様に連絡は取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. The slip alone does not confirm representative-collection conditions. I will check the parcel record. Can you contact your brother?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 休憩時間なら電話できます。確認が必要なら、勝手に受け取らず兄に聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄の休憩中に連絡でき勝手には受け取らないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can call during his break. If confirmation is needed, I will ask him rather than collect it without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain you can call during your brother's break and will not collect without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を確認できました。この荷物は宛名にあるご本人が受け取る扱いです。お兄様が窓口に来られなければ、ご本人が在宅する日に再配達を申し込む方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I checked the record. This parcel must be collected by the named recipient. If your brother cannot come to the counter, he can request redelivery on a day he is home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 再配達なら兄が在宅する日にしたいです。私がこの票から勝手に日時を決めても問題ありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 兄がいる日にしたく自分だけで日時を決めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: For redelivery, I would like a day my brother is home. Is it all right if I decide the date and time myself using this slip?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may choose the date and time yourself for a day your brother is home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まずお兄様のご都合を確認してください。この票の案内に沿って、ご本人からお申し込みいただくと確実です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: First check your brother's availability. It is safest for him to apply following this slip's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここでは私が受け取れないんですね。不在票を持ち帰って兄に渡し、在宅する日に再配達を申し込んでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分は窓口で受け取れないと理解し不在票を兄へ渡して在宅日の再配達を申し込んでもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: So I cannot collect it here. I will take the slip home, give it to my brother and have him request redelivery on a day he is home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you understand you cannot collect at the counter, and will give the slip to your brother to request redelivery for a day at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その方法でお願いいたします。不在票はお返しします。お手数をおかけしました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please do that. Here is the slip back. Sorry for the trouble. Please travel home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お困りのようですね。窓口でどのようなお手続きをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem to need help. What procedure would you like at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらのキャッシュカードが入った財布をなくしました。まだ探していますが、先にカードを止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布を捜索中だがキャッシュカードを先に止めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my wallet containing this bank's cash card. I am still looking, but want to stop the card first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are still searching for the wallet but want to stop the cash card first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用停止を優先しましょう。カードを最後に使ったのはいつですか。ご本人確認ができる物もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us prioritize suspension. When did you last use the card? Do you also have identification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方に使いました。財布とは別に保管していた在留カードを持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日夕方に使い別保管の在留カードを持っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday evening. I have my residence card, which I kept separately from my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you used it yesterday evening and have a residence card kept separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認のため、こちらの用紙にお名前とご住所をご記入ください。暗証番号を声に出していただく必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. To confirm, write your name and address on this form. There is no need to say your PIN aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と住所を書きました。カードを止めると、会社からの給料の振り込みも止まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 氏名住所を記入したと伝えカード停止で給与振り込みも止まるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written my name and address. If the card is stopped, will salary transfers from my company also stop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you filled name and address, and ask whether card suspension also stops salary transfers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: キャッシュカードの利用停止は、口座への振り込みを止める手続きとは別です。本人確認ができましたので、ただいまカードの停止を登録しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Suspending cash-card use is separate from stopping incoming transfers to the account. Your identity is confirmed, so I have now registered the card suspension.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 給料の振り込みは受けられるんですね。もし帰宅後に財布が見つかっても、そのカードをすぐ使ってよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入金は可能と理解し財布発見時にカードをすぐ使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I can still receive salary transfers. If I find the wallet after going home, may I use that card straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show you understand deposits remain possible and ask about immediate card use if the wallet is found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 停止済みですので、そのまま使わず当行にご連絡ください。見つかった場合の扱いと再発行について、手続きに応じてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is suspended, so do not use it as it is; contact our bank. We will explain what happens if found and reissuance according to the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかっても使わずに連絡します。今日は停止できたことがわかる控えを受け取って帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見しても使わず銀行に連絡し停止受付の控えを受け取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact you without using it even if found. Today I would like to take home a record showing the suspension was completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the bank without using a found card and want a suspension-acceptance record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 受付内容を記載したこちらの控えをお渡しします。大切に保管してください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is a record of what was accepted. Please keep it carefully. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋の商品についてのご相談でしょうか。サービスカウンターで伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the item in the bag? We will listen at the service counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日ここで買った切り分けのかぼちゃです。今朝、包丁を入れたら中が黒くなっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入した切り分けのかぼちゃを切ると中が黒かったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is a cut portion of pumpkin bought here yesterday. When I cut into it this morning, it was black inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the cut pumpkin bought yesterday was black inside when cut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切るまでは傷みに気づかなかったのですね。購入後はどのように保管されていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You did not notice deterioration until cutting it. How did you store it after purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰宅してすぐ冷蔵庫に入れました。まだ調理していませんし、食べてもいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅後すぐ冷蔵し調理も食事もしていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I put it straight in the refrigerator after getting home. I have neither cooked nor eaten it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you refrigerated it immediately after returning home and have neither cooked nor eaten it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現品を確認します。傷んだ部分がありますね。購入した時間やレシートはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the item. There is a spoiled area. Do you know the purchase time or have the receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の午後六時ごろです。レシートはなくしましたが、会員アプリに購入履歴が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入は昨日十八時ごろでレシートはないがアプリの履歴があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around six yesterday evening. I lost the receipt, but the membership app still has the purchase history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it was bought around eighteen hundred yesterday, no receipt remains, but the app has the history. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その履歴で商品と購入日が確認できました。当店で切り分けた商品ですので、今回は返金いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The history confirms the item and purchase date. Since we cut it in this shop, we will refund it this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返金でお願いします。同じ売り場に残っている物も、中の状態を確認していただけませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金を希望し残っている同じ商品の状態確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: A refund, please. Could you also check inside the same products still on the shelf?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a refund and a condition check of the remaining same products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者に確認を依頼します。こちらの商品は調査のため店でお預かりしますが、よろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the person responsible to check. May we keep this item in the shop for investigation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、全部お預けします。返金の記録も受け取って、今日は別の野菜を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現品全部を預け返金の記録を受け取り別の野菜を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will leave all of it. I will take the refund record and choose a different vegetable today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the entire item, take the refund record and choose another vegetable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 返金の控えはこちらです。お手数をおかけしました。お申し出ありがとうございます。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your refund record. Sorry for the trouble. Thank you for letting us know. Please come again.
